The project

Put the finish on one of Teneriffe’s best addresses

Ducale is a nine-level collection of just 26 homes at 33 Wyandra Street, Teneriffe, capturing views across the Brisbane River, the CBD and Teneriffe Hill. Designed by BYculprit, it’s a slender, softly curved tower wrapped in layered landscaping, with a palette that blends Italian heritage with Brisbane’s riverside character.

These are big, family-sized homes, from 126m² to 291m²: two to four bedroom residences, double-storey family apartments, ground-floor homes with private plunge pools, and a four-bedroom penthouse and sub-penthouse at the top.

On the roof there’s a pool with cabanas and daybeds, a gym, dining and BBQ terraces and a work-from-home lounge. It’s also future-ready, with fast EV charging and a drone delivery landing zone.

Where the job is at

Structure done. Now it’s show time.

Ducale’s structure tops out within weeks. From there it’s the fun part: the facade goes on, the finishing trades flood in and the building starts to look like the renders.

Melrose already has one finishes foreman on site and is adding a second, a Finishes & Facade Foreman, for the run home. You’ll own your floors and the external envelope, keep the trades moving in the right sequence and make sure every apartment is finished to the standard these buyers paid for.

What matters most

Attitude is everything here

This one is about the person as much as the CV. We want a foreman who is genuinely excited to come in with fresh energy, get stuck into the facade and finishes, and help bring Ducale home with the rest of the team.

Excited to finishYou love the back end of a job, when it all comes together.

What you’re finishing

Detail that buyers paid for

The role

Make it look like the renders.

What you’ll do

  • Drive the facade and external envelope, plus the finishing trades across your floors.
  • Sequence trades day to day: framing, linings, waterproofing, tiling, joinery, painting and more.
  • Run short-term lookaheads with the Site Manager and keep your areas on program.
  • Own quality on the ground: ITPs, inspections and a luxury finish every time.
  • Close out defects and get apartments ready for a clean handover.
  • Keep a safe, tidy, well-run site and lead the trades from the front.

Who we’re looking for

  • An experienced Finishes Foreman, Facade Foreman or General Foreman.
  • Multi-residential or high-end residential experience in Brisbane.
  • Strong across facade, internal finishes, defects and handover.
  • A great attitude. Excited to come in and help bring Ducale home.
  • A team player who works well with the Site Manager, the other foremen and the trades.
  • A track record of staying with a builder and finishing what you start.
  • Looking for a long-term home with a builder that’s growing fast.
The developer

Frank Developments is a Brisbane and Gold Coast developer behind some of the inner north’s most considered residential projects. Led by Managing Director Frank Licastro, Frank builds big, beautifully designed homes for people who want to live in the inner city, and future-proofs every project for how people will live next.

Ducale, delivered with Epoca Property Group, is one of their flagship projects. It’s a client that cares about detail, and a building that will carry your name for a long time.
